note: Set-up: colored-side-up diamond. Source: https://origami.me/bird/
1a: Precrease vertically.
1b: Precrease horizontally.
2: Turn over.
3a: Precrease between opposite edge midpoints.
3b: Repeat for the other midpoints.
4a: Begin the square-base collapse by bringing the upper point down.
4b: Fold the two-ply left half over to the right.
4c: Squash the first pocket.
4d: Turn over to expose the remaining pocket.
4e: Squash the second pocket to complete the square base.
5a: Fold the front left edge to the center.
5b: Fold the front right edge to the center.
6: Fold the upper triangle down.
7a: Lift the top triangle temporarily to release the side flaps (as shown in the tutorial video).
7b: Reopen the left lower kite flap along its existing crease.
7c: Reopen the right lower kite flap along its existing crease.
7d: Lower the top triangle again; this is the flat endpoint shown before the petal fold.
8a: Open the top triangle along the petal hinge before lifting the front flap.
8b: Lift the lower front flap and collapse the existing kite creases into the first petal.
9: Turn over.
10a: Precrease the lower left edge to the center.
10b: Precrease the lower right edge to the center.
11: Petal fold the lower front flap upward to complete the bird base.
12: Flip the front left flap to the right.
12: Turn over to the other side.
12: Flip the back left flap to the right.
12: Turn over to the other side.
13: Lift the front lower flap.
13: Turn over to the other side.
13: Lift the back lower flap.
13: Turn over to the other side.
